test_game_registered: test the python module loads the ant_foraging game via pyspiel.load_game and verifies its short name
test_default_parameters: test the python module ant_foraging game has correct default parameters for num_players, grid_size, num_food, and max_turns
test_initial_state: test the python module ant_foraging creates a new initial state with correct current_player, non-terminal status, and zero returns
test_legal_actions: test the python module ant_foraging state returns legal actions including STAY and at most 5 total actions
test_apply_action: test the python module ant_foraging state applies an action and switches to the next player
test_turn_progression: test the python module ant_foraging alternates turns between player 0 and player 1 correctly
test_game_terminates: test the python module ant_foraging game reaches a terminal state after repeated action applications
test_random_simulation: test the python module ant_foraging runs random simulations without crashes and returns valid player returns
test_action_to_string: test the python module ant_foraging converts an action to a string representation containing the action name
